name: PRICEMAT
description: PRICEMAT returns the price per $100 face value of a security that pays all interest at maturity.
tldr: Calculates the price of a security that pays interest at maturity.

basicExample.explanation: Calculates the price of a security issued January 1, 2024 with a 6% issue rate and 5% yield.

advancedExamples.title: With actual/365 basis
advancedExamples.explanation: Basis 3 counts actual days and uses a 365-day year.

howItWorks: PRICEMAT calculates the price of a security that pays interest at maturity by discounting the redemption and interest payment at the yield.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Issue date must be before maturity.

commonErrors.fix: Verify all inputs and date order.
Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: PRICEMAT works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between PRICEMAT and PRICE?
faq.answer: PRICEMAT is for securities that pay interest at maturity. PRICE is for periodic coupon-paying bonds.

faq.question: When is PRICEMAT used?
faq.answer: It is used for zero-coupon bonds and certificates of deposit that pay interest at maturity.
